name: Sound On, Guess the Shop
why_it_works: Sound is the most ignored part of a process and the most satisfying. Asking viewers to guess from sound alone turns watching into a game, keeps them listening to the end for the answer, and the guesses fill the comments.

hook.pattern: Black screen, a real process sound, and a guessing challenge.
examples: Sound on. Guess what we're making.
Three sounds. One {{finished_thing}}. Guess before the reveal.
If you know this sound, you know {{brand}}.

variables.name: finished_thing
variables.description: What the sounds add up to

visual.prompt: Extreme macro of the tool making {{sound_one}} at {{brand}}, abstract and hard to identify, single hard light, dark background, vertical 9:16
Extreme macro of {{sound_two}}, texture and motion only, no wide context, moody side light, vertical 9:16
Extreme macro of {{sound_three}}, slow and tactile, steam or particles in the light, vertical 9:16
Clean, proud wide shot of the finished {{finished_thing}} at {{brand}}, warm light, the tools from the macro shots visible nearby, vertical 9:16

craft.notes: Record the real sounds clean and loud; the AI clips are just texture under them, so keep the visuals macro and ambiguous. Withhold the wide shot until the reveal. No voiceover until the comment prompt.

do_not: Use stock sound effects instead of the real process audio
Show a wide shot early and give the answer away
Use any copyrighted music under the sounds
